verdict.rationale: Rainforest documents amount splits, payout/deposit configuration, merchant billing profiles (fees), and webhooks for status changes, which together give a partial traceability chain from charge to split to payout. However, there is no explicit documentation of a ledger, per-seller balance view, or fee-account balance report, nor any mention of penny-level reconciliation tooling. missing for 10: explicit balance-by-seller/fee-account reporting, dedicated reconciliation/ledger documentation, evidence of penny-level accuracy guarantees.
